extra_constraints:
- Sandbox limits you must report as Deviations instead of working around: `npm run e2e` (needs the running stack), `npm run check-contrast` and the full `npm run test` (the `tsx` runner cannot open its IPC pipe here), `dotnet test`. Run `npx vitest run <file>` per touched or added spec instead, plus `npm run build`, `npx eslint <files>`, `npx prettier --check <files>` on every touched file. Hand the orchestrator the exact e2e, check-contrast, and full-suite commands.
- Evidence files under docs/plans/ are the orchestrator's; do not create or edit anything under docs/ or under backend/, frontend/src/app/api/generated/, backend/openapi/, or frontend/src/components/ui/.
- Every copy string comes from spec section 4.1; source strings are sentence case (CSS uppercases); write U+2014, U+00B7, U+2192, U+2026 as `\u2014`, `\u00B7`, `\u2192`, `\u2026` escapes in TSX and in tests; never bake uppercase into a stored string.
- Semantic tokens only (no raw hex, no `--alp-faint` on essential text); every animation pairs a `motion-reduce:` variant; 44px targets on every interactive element; the canonical 3px ring comes from the primitives, do not restyle it.
- Every test you add must be able to fail against the gap it names; for each, write in the Mutations section the one-line mutation that turns it red (spec section 5 lists the expected red line per criterion). Never loosen or delete a preserved test; the preserved test names are enumerated in spec section 3.
- Dual-theme tests use `renderInBothThemes` and `expectDualThemeParity` from frontend/src/app/modules/common/test-utils/render-in-both-themes.tsx.
- Lint traps measured in this repo: `sonarjs/void-use` (wrap a discarded member-promise in a local `Promise<void>` arrow, never `void obj.method()`), `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` (no synchronous setState inside an effect), `sonarjs/cognitive-complexity` (extract helpers), `sonarjs/no-hardcoded-passwords` (fixture lines take the sibling `// eslint-disable-next-line sonarjs/no-hardcoded-passwords` comment).

- Sign-out (spec 4.5): the logout POST is awaited first; `loggedOut()`, `apiSlice.util.resetApiState()`, and `postLogoutBroadcast()` run in `finally` in that order; a rejection is reported through `reportClientError` with kind `unhandled-rejection`; the receiver dispatches `loggedOut()` then `resetApiState()`; no explicit navigation.
